context_requirements: Expression of functional 5-HT2/5-HT3/5-HT4 receptors; many lines lack or express low levels of these GPCRs/ion channels
Intact Gq/PLC or cAMP signaling for 5-HT2/5-HT4-mediated immediate-early gene induction
Proliferative signaling that can be modestly attenuated by 5-HT2B/5-HT2C-mediated G1 arrest
falsifiers: No reproducible change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Strong, dose-dependent induction of canonical 5-HT2/5-HT4 immediate-early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h in all lines
Marked proliferation_down or apoptosis signature at 24 h across most lines

changes: Removed TOP2A from proximal_down because it is a replication/S-phase gene, not a proximal transcriptional target of serotonin receptor signaling; it remains in late_down.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, MYC, MYBL2, E2F2, CDK2, CDK4, CDK6, PCNA, MCM3, GMNN, CDC45, ORC1) from proximal_down; these are downstream cell-cycle effects, not proximal receptor targets.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, UBE2C, KIF20A, KIF2C, NUSAP1) from late_down; these are generic proliferation_down effects, not mechanism-specific late targets.

Removed DUSP4, DUSP6, IER3, FOSL1, BHLHE40, ZFP36, NFIL3, CXCL2, PTGS2, GADD45B from late_up because they are immediate-early/proximal genes and duplicate the proximal_up list; late_up should contain only secondary response genes.
Removed TRIB1, TRIB3, SOCS2, SERPINE1 from late_up because they are generic stress/inflammation genes rather than specific serotonin receptor partial agonist late targets.
Kept kinetics as slow and magnitude weak because a partial agonist at 10 micromolar is expected to produce modest, delayed transcriptional effects.
Kept all line_response values as weak because none of the nine lines is known to express a full complement of functional 5-HT2/5-HT3/5-HT4 receptors at levels that would support strong responses.
Kept evidence empty because no citations were provided and no abstract-supported claims can be verified.
